name: LayerGrab
summary: Splits any image into named, editable layers (up to 16), fills the background behind them, and exports PNG, ZIP or a layered PSD, plus Photoshop, Figma, Sketch and Chrome plugins.
description: Splits any image into named, editable layers (up to 16), fills the background behind them, and exports PNG, ZIP or a layered PSD, plus Photoshop, Figma, Sketch and Chrome plugins.

pricing.details: Basic 11 €/month (1,200 credits, about 120 layers) or 88 €/year; Premium 32 €/month (3,600 credits, about 450 layers) or 267 €/year (yearly saves 31%). One-time packs (pack credits expire): 18 € for 1,800 credits (about 180 layers); 54 € for 6,600 credits.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Splits an image into up to 16 named, editable transparent layers, and fills the background
PNG, ZIP or layered PSD export
Photoshop, Figma, Sketch and Chrome plugins
Pay per returned layer; one-time pack credits expire
